## Cost: an estimate, and a ceiling

V7's EXECUTION_COST_CEILING, 1.316316, was the body-based input estimate plus all 128000 output tokens at the held price: a planning figure, carried here under that name and never as a bound, because strict tool use adds provider-side input of undocumented size.
